Welcome to Sunrise Dental Care

Located in the heart of Williamsburg, we provide comprehensive and gentle dental care for the Brooklyn community. From routine cleanings to advanced cosmetic procedures, our team is dedicated to your oral health and comfort.

Our Dental Services

General Dentistry

Comprehensive cleanings, exams, and preventative care

Cosmetic Dentistry

Teeth whitening, veneers, and smile makeovers

Implants

State-of-the-art dental implant procedures

Orthodontics

Modern braces and Invisalign treatments

What Our Patients Say
